writer: Senior Engineer (delegated writer; no git write commands run)

findings.change: packages/mpd-tui-adapter-plugin/src/index.ts runTick: the loadPrefs().then fulfilled callback body is now contained in try/catch; any throw from the side-panel read, the migration write or the post-write read settles 'refused' with 'the migration decision path threw: <message>' instead of rejecting the promise .then returned (the rejection handler covers loadPrefs only).
findings.test: panel-enable-migration.test.ts — '(R2.1) a store whose apply throws settles a recorded refusal — zero unhandled rejections' (process.on('unhandledRejection') collector asserted empty).

findings.change: New latched 'stopped' flag set in stop() before the releases; checked at the top of the runTick fulfilled callback (no migration, no belt install, no decide from a probe that resolved after stop()), at the top of decide() (feed events a host's missing unsubscribe leaves attached), and at the top of the belt listener.
findings.test: panel-enable-migration.test.ts — '(R2.2) a loadPrefs() resolving AFTER stop() neither migrates nor installs the belt' (manual-promise probe) and '(R2.2) a belt the host never gave an unsubscribe for stays silent after stop()' (store whose subscribe returns undefined).

findings.change: migrateStaleDefaultOnSelfHealer now returns PanelSelfHealMigration ('migrated' | 'refused' | 'none'); standDownToHostUnion takes the verdict and settles 'refused' (message: standing down … but the stale-default migration write was refused, so the stale list remains; the belt re-evaluates on the host's next apply) instead of 'confirmed'. The 'migrated'/'none' settle line is byte-identical to pre-R2.
findings.test: panel-enable-migration.test.ts — '(R2.3) a host that drops the migration write settles REFUSED, never confirmed' (store that records the apply but keeps the stale pin; also asserts the belt re-attempt and its refusal log line).

findings.change: scripts/mpd-tui-panels.ts: new tuiSettingsOperand() refuses a missing or dash-prefixed --tui-settings operand with a named error carried on Options.argRefusal; main() prints 'REFUSED: …' and exits 1 before anything is read or written. A valid operand passes through unchanged.
findings.test: self-test arms '(R2.4) --tui-settings --apply is refused by name', '(R2.4) a trailing --tui-settings is refused by name', '(R2.4) a valid operand is carried through unchanged', '(R2.4) the trailing flag refuses the run itself (exit 1)'.

findings.change: scripts/mpd-tui-panels.ts: the patch-layer write (backup copy, staged write, rename, read-back) is contained in try/catch; a read-back mismatch OR a thrown copy/stage/rename goes through refusePatchWrite(), which names BOTH layers' backups in the one refusal and restores the settings backup automatically (best-effort, failure named). With no settings write this run the refusal message is byte-identical to pre-R2.
findings.test: self-test arms '(R2.5) a patch write that fails after a settings write REFUSES (exit 1)', '(R2.5) the settings layer is restored BYTE-IDENTICAL', '(R2.5) the refusal names BOTH layers' backups' — end-to-end main() over a scratch profile; the read-back mismatch is forced deterministically by an --ids operand with an embedded newline (the one-line leaf cannot round-trip it).

preR2BehaviourPreserved: The 'confirmed' stand-down settle line, the settings-layer read-back refusal, the loadPrefs rejection handler, and every pre-0.15.0 path are unchanged; existing arms (a)-(g) and all pre-0.15.0 arms pass unmodified.
rebuild: .toolchain/node_modules/.bin/bun build packages/mpd-tui-plugin/src/index.ts --target node --format esm --outfile packages/mpd-tui-plugin/dist/index.js (bun 1.4.0, repo root; the only package whose src imports the adapter)
